items.text:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy scandal, prompting tighter US chip export rules

• Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after a series of controversies that surfaced in late 2025 and early 2026.
• Congress seeks stricter AI chip export limits after Nvidia spy scandal, urging Nvidia executives to testify.
• Pony.ai is using mid-tier compute and Chinese-made chips to offset Nvidia supply limits.
